mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 61 degrees.

The city has released an update regarding engineering services with AECOM Incorporated. Additionally, the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is inviting residents to public meetings for the US 18/151 Corridor Study, with an in-person meeting on November 18 and a virtual option on November 19 to discuss design concepts.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Today you can enjoy Hop Haus Trivia or Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow brings Dream Day Trivia, live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and trivia night at The Bogey Factory.
Regarding local activity, on October 23, officers made contact with two 13-year-old juveniles riding prohibited eMotos on Ashton Drive, resulting in citations for their parents.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist. The restaurant is currently open, so you have until 10:00 PM tonight to stop by and enjoy a scoop.
